_comment: Known statuses that override the auto-matcher. Keyed by VB control/symbol name. Sourced from docs/PARITY.md, the dead-chrome audit, and the migration handoff memory. status in {Ported, Partial, Deferred, Divergence, MISSING}. Extend this file as the sweep verifies rows.

deferred_fileview_nav.note: LazWorks FileView Navigator/CurrentFolder model not ported (structural divergence).

deferred_shared_store.note: SharedNit/BackupManager network-share sync; low value single-machine, no NRBF writer.

deferred_features.note: Needs an unported subsystem/editor; tracked in handoff.

intentional_divergence.note: Intentional cross-platform / config-isolation omission; left visible-but-disabled by design.

confirmed_findings.note: Confirmed divergence found during audit design (2026-07-15) — see DASHBOARD.md Findings. Method partly ported; the empty-group render behavior is the missing unit.

_swept_files_comment: Rows below were classified by the sweep (evidence in git/grep). NIT.ModView.vb swept 2026-07-15 as the first demonstration file.

modview_deferred_autorestorers.note: Auto-restorer subsystem (VB AutoOriginalRestorer family) — grep confirms not ported; = the tracked MsCreateOriginalRestorers deferral.

modview_divergence_inline_props.note: VB edits Rating/Weapon/props inline in the details pane; port moved them to ModPropertiesDialog (intended). Per-widget notes font = app-level theme.
